searchText: Hi, it's possible to add more bootstrap nodes But we are reluctant to do it because in the past, other bootnodes that we had listed disappeared without notice. It's kind of a hassle to keep checking if those nodes exist Nowadays, we also use DNS-based bootstrapping And we are happy to share the responsibility of maintaining DNS node lists with others You can find more information about this in https://geth.ethereum.org/docs/developers/dns-discovery-setup If your project is running nodes, you could publish them as a DNS node list and share the `enrtree://` URL with us. We would then add it as a link in our DNS list. hehe, just realized I'm replying to a message from many months ago 🙂
